source: Steamworks SDK interface headers, one entry per interface version
format: each version's slots are one row each: [method, returns] or [method, returns, params], a parameter being [name, type] with "out" or "unmarshalable" after it. A type is a kind from steambridge_codegen's table or a value class or structure declared here. A row that says more carries an object of notes as its last element, and the vtable's destructor slot is ["~"] - or ["~", notes] for the one the SDK gives a flat name.
